question: The Asian Football Cup is held once in ___
solution:
The correct answer is __**4 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Asian Football Cup, also known as the AFC Asian Cup, is the primary football competition in Asia for national teams.
 
• It is organized by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) and is one of the most prestigious tournaments in the region.
 
• The tournament is held every 4 years, similar to the UEFA European Championship and the Copa América.
 
• The first AFC Asian Cup was held in 1956, and since then, it has grown significantly in popularity and scale.
 
• The most recent edition of the tournament was held in 2019 in the United Arab Emirates, with Qatar emerging as the champions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **AFC (Asian Football Confederation)**

 
 
• The AFC is the governing body of football in Asia and Australia and is one of the six continental confederations of FIFA.
 
• It is responsible for organizing major Asian tournaments including the AFC Asian Cup, AFC Champions League, and AFC Cup.
 
• The AFC was founded on 8 May 1954 in Manila, Philippines.
 
• The headquarters of the AFC is located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
 
 
 
• **Qatar's Victory in 2019**
 
 
• Qatar won their first AFC Asian Cup in 2019, defeating Japan 3-1 in the final.
 
• This victory was seen as a significant achievement for Qatar, especially as it prepares to host the FIFA World Cup in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Upcoming Tournaments**
 
 
• The next AFC Asian Cup will be held in 2023, with China being the host nation.
 
• Preparations and qualifications for the tournament are already underway, with teams vying for a spot in the prestigious competition.
 
 
 
• **Format of the Tournament**
 
 
• The tournament typically features 24 national teams, which are divided into groups for the group stage.
 
• The top teams from each group progress to the knockout stages, culminating in the final to determine the champion.
 
• The competition format ensures a high level of excitement and competition among the participating teams.
